newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-KISS COSTS ROMEO A GAME. THAT'S AMORE!.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KISS COSTS ROMEO A GAME. THAT'S AMORE!.

text.p: A player who kissed the referee when she sent him off the field learned on Friday love does not run deep in Italian soccer.
Alessandro Veronese's demonstration of "amore" was called "unusually intimate" by local sporting judge Sergio Rigo and earned him a one-match suspension.
Veronese, 26, will have to sit out the next two matches for his amateur league club Battaglia -- one for the sending off and an extra one for pecking referee Anna Di Toni on both cheeks.
The woman medical student dismissed Veronese last weekend after his second booking during Battaglia's 2-0 win over Rocca.
"We think there are going to be a lot more woman referees around in a few years time," Rigo said.
"What's going to happen if players think they have the right to kiss them or stroke their hair?"
